findings.detail: The lower hinge arm is parented to sag, not door; it remains at the cabinet-side authored position while the door swings. Its plate is visual only. The click rule checks only sag and arm displacement, with no swing/alignment or hook engagement condition. Thus it can conceptually reclip from a door configuration where the real door-mounted hinge is elsewhere. Need actual linkage/contact or clearly justified kinematics and adversarial validation before submission.

Add a red-team attempt that levels the door after closing it and presses the stationary lower arm; also press the arm with door far from its clip-on engagement angle. Full credit for such a physically impossible engagement would invalidate construction.
